prompt_md: Round pizzas, all equally thick. How many 15 cm pizzas give you the same amount of pizza as one 30 cm pizza?
prompt_short: How many 15 cm pizzas equal one 30 cm pizza?
hint_md: Area grows with the square of the width.
explain_intuition_md: Doubling the width doubles it in both directions, so the area grows four times. The big pizza is worth four small ones, not two.
